title: D01b: isolate approved capacity ceilings and owner matchers
body:
## Scope

Capacity-only: central ceiling exactly **400,000 non-whitespace characters**, kernel bundle ceiling **900 KiB (921,600 bytes)**, candidate-measured owner ceilings at +5% rounded up, and complete companion matchers. Per-file, complexity, nesting and width gates remain unchanged. Unmeasured owner groups retain historical allowances. `quality-baseline.json` records approved ceilings, not clean-runtime counts.

No kernel runtime source changes, schema-2 activation, migration/bridge qualification, tag or release. The tech-spec table explicitly describes the reconciled **uncommitted candidate**, not this PR's runtime. The changelog's pending-CI statement records the status when that commit was written; qualification below is the subsequent evidence.

## Dependency instructions

Final head: `49aea1819985c904cfb615ae73319221b2640832`, based on `fe475fbb26cd5690a35f33acbb2371c902f3dc58`.

Fetch `origin/vedprakash-m-d01-capacity-ceilings`, then cherry-pick in order:

1. `c69403652bb680026dc34bcdf03a5d24e0c1553f` — tooling/tests; original `f5ad92cf8b4e08ff930f88bc7b804d53b442deec`.
2. `225b43cfd9ca12c78e00f248a26b4e68ab839732` — canonical tech-spec/changelog; original `1acf8bf8b1d8d69c0f9a7ac52a165000433ea8ed`.
3. `070bb23b68baf17cbfb755779c81ea3000aba127` — shared portability repair: exact 921,600-byte acceptance / 921,601-byte refusal with checksum invalidation.
4. `49aea1819985c904cfb615ae73319221b2640832` — related changelog evidence.

Do not apply both original and cherry-picked histories. Branches already carrying the original pair need only the shared test repair and any applicable documentation reconciliation. No dependency on uncommitted schema-2 code.

## Clean-runtime evidence

| Owner | Measured characters | Approved ceiling |
|---|---:|---:|
| Central | 248,251 | 400,000 |
| Schemas | 42,701 | 77,396 |
| Budget | 8,806 | 33,654 |
| Store | 26,535 | 55,863 |
| Git CLI | 37,843 | 39,718 |
| Runner | 9,943 | 15,771 |
| Node/TypeScript | 20,150 | 21,158 |
| Review | 18,276 | 20,832 |
| Risk | 4,779 | 5,018 |
| Verdict | 13,419 | 15,451 |

`tenet.mjs`: **800,807 bytes**, versus a 921,600-byte allowance. Local typecheck, all lints, coverage, build, payload and reproducibility pass. Reproducibility covers 97 files; manifest SHA-256 `037eb20995d6d6d8584cf88c5714890bf4f865ed8189c8ddf3e44d9ee1bc7cc1`.

Quality controls **12/12**; revised portability plus quality controls **23/23**; final-head applicable Windows cohort **376/376**. Full local Windows CI was stopped after unsupported mutating-POSIX failures including directory `fsync` EPERM; it is **not** full-suite qualification.

## Exact-head hosted qualification

**PASS:** [untrusted push run 42408560105](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42408560105), head `49aea1819985c904cfb615ae73319221b2640832`. Ubuntu and macOS each pass full `npm run ci` (**1,748/1,748 tests**) and built-bundle UAT on **Node 24 and Node 22.12**. Windows portability also passes.

The PR-event run initially failed only the macOS nested-watch canary timeout in unchanged `read-only-review.test.ts` (**1,747/1,748**, attempt 1); Ubuntu and Windows passed. Retry attempt 2 then passed macOS (**1,748/1,748**); [run 42408676871](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42408676871) now has all three exact-head checks successful. Separately, [push run 42408560105](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42408560105), attempt 1, passed Ubuntu/macOS full CI and UAT plus Windows portability. The transient failure and retry provenance are retained; no watcher code or evaluator was weakened.

Native-host behavior remains unobserved. Staged and range privacy checks before pushes found nothing. **Do not merge; preserve the public review window.**
